member_view_visibility: member-visible canonical bytes are regenerated from this recipe but this recipe itself is not a battery input

logging_policy.definition: frozen trajectory sets for LOG-PARITY generated by a declared non-adaptive mixture logging policy

mixture.policy: passive: task actions only, round-robin over topics
uniform random over full action set incl. probes
fixed probe schedule, probe-rate 0.2, uniform placement

logging_policy.rationale: predictor-class members must see probe outcomes in the log (fairness); no adaptive information in the log itself
